description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'ClaimEventSearchFilterParams' used for filtering claim event searches within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes properties for name, status, and id, along with getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: ClaimEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for filtering claim event search results, including properties for name, status, and id, with associated accessor methods. Extends the base FilterParams class to include sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object with default sort field 'claimEvent.name'.
